doc.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: A romance by mail with his future wife
summary: They correspond three years before she comes to the United States.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So after you came back, you went back into a show.
I went back and started working in theaters again.
And you continued your correspondence with your wife, who you met on the train platform.
Did you get to go back to Sweden?
Not at all, no. I didn’t see my wife again until she came here. My wife came here.
How long after you met her did she come to the States?
Three years. It was three years afterwards.
So you kept on a correspondence for three years.
Oh yeah. We started – the letters began to become more and more numerous.
So this was really a romance by mail.
